task_assessment.objective: Finish the nominal_single_tone request after clipping and harmonic distortion are both ruled out.

claims.statement: Clipping is excluded by clipping_mechanism=false and the clipping rules PASS. In nominal_single_tone mode, contextual harmonic analysis is valid, F0 matches the declared fundamental, and the harmonic-growth rule PASSes, so no supported S1 distortion cause is established relative to the declared single-tone context.

limitations: This no_supported_fault conclusion is relative to the declared nominal_single_tone context and does not exclude distortion mechanisms outside the S1 clipping and harmonic_distortion families.
